mapper.insert: INSERT INTO congestion_info (line_number, station_name, congestion_level, train_no, arrival_message, updated_at) VALUES (#{lineNumber}, #{stationName}, #{congestionLevel}, #{trainNo}, #{arrivalMessage}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE congestion_level = VALUES(congestion_level), train_no = VALUES(train_no), arrival_message = VALUES(arrival_message), updated_at = NOW()
